name: Sam Sadowski
source:
Juliet's boyfriend, a talented mechanic.
They have been together since high school, their relationship is pretty solid.
Of a rather careless temperament, he is nevertheless determined to get a promotion in the garage where he works.
He would like to be able to move downtown with Juliet.
